patches.title: sfx1017: Sidecar mods (recommended)
patches.description: External voice machines (PLAITS, DAISYSP) on every track, the SEND FX 1/2 pages (AMPLITUDE 2; TYPE and P1..P5 with the Sidecar's FX labels), and the TEENSY folder in the sample browser.

patches.title: rui1017: sfx1017 + remote UI (early)
patches.description: Everything in sfx1017, plus the early remote UI page (hold TRK, press YES). The Sidecar does not serve remote UI pages yet: the page stays blank and returns to the normal screen within about a second.
